root_cause.exact_project_observation: The F2 S1 runner installs misaki[de] at the pinned Misaki commit, then imports KModel and KPipeline during IMPORT_PREFLIGHT.
root_cause.exact_upstream_observation: Pinned Kokoro pipeline.py imports `from misaki import en, espeak` at module import time before selecting the German DEG2P path.
root_cause.exact_misaki_observation: Pinned Misaki pyproject declares spacy<4 under optional extra [en] but not under [de]; pinned misaki/en.py imports spacy at module import time.
root_cause.conclusion: misaki[de] alone is insufficient for importing the pinned Kokoro KPipeline even when only German synthesis is intended. The failure occurs before model/artifact execution and therefore is not a Kokoro/Piper product-quality negative.

minimal_trigger4_repair_guidance.preferred_delta: Keep the exact Kokoro/Misaki/model pins and add an explicit compatible spaCy pin to PYTHON_RUNTIME_PINS before the existing misaki[de] install. Current verified PyPI release at research time: spacy==3.8.16, satisfying Misaki's spacy<4 declaration and Python 3.12 support.
